hebrewText: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/יְנַהֵ֖ג בְּ/עֻזּ֣/וֹ תֵימָֽן

tokens.bdb: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney
tokens.kjv: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.

tokens.bdb: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh
tokens.kjv: acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

tokens.bdb: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
tokens.kjv: boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong.

tokens.bdb: the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east)
